page.overview:
Who is Akarrin Comeris?

Akarrin Comeris is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah, who has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She is slim, with quick eyes. She has a plain brown wool dress, and a cloak with surprisingly elaborate green embroidery. She nodded for emphasis with almost every other word.

Akarrin is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of the series. Egwene thinks that "Akarrin was not strong in the Power, little more than Siuan if at all". In fact, this is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

Akarrin is 199 years old. She was born in and went to the White Tower in the series. After eleven years as a novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in 837 NE.
